candidates.change_summary: Change the permission check to require(msg.sender == _ownerAddress || isAdmin[msg.sender]) so non-admin owner can no longer update but admins can; this alters who can successfully call and thus can change winnersPerPeriod observed after a call.
Remove the access control check so anyone can call updateWinnersPerPeriod, potentially changing winnersPerPeriod after calls by previously unauthorized callers.
Invert the access control check to require(!isAdmin[msg.sender]) which blocks admins and allows non-admins, changing which calls succeed and thus the stored value.
Require the caller to be the contract owner only (msg.sender == _ownerAddress) instead of isAdmin, changing who can update the variable and observable outcome.
Change assignment to increment winnersPerPeriod by newWinnersPerPeriodAmount rather than overwrite, altering the resulting stored value after a call.
Change assignment to set winnersPerPeriod to newWinnersPerPeriodAmount + 1, producing a different stored value after successful calls.
Change assignment to set winnersPerPeriod to newWinnersPerPeriodAmount - 1, altering observed value (note: underflow protected by solidity >=0.8 causes revert if zero).
